# Scaffold article-analysis agent with run inputs, token auth, GET context, empty run, batch cap, and reanalyze bounds

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

Adds the `article-analysis` agent package using the same Hermes agent patterns as existing Mediapulse agents. Validates run input per FR1, calls analysis GET with `unanalyzed=true` when `reanalyze` is false and the appropriate flag when true, exits successfully when no sources are eligible, and applies `maxBatchSize` and deterministic ordering (for example by `createdAt`) when the eligible set is larger than the cap.

## Scope

- In scope: New agent under `apps/mediapulse/agents/` (or monorepo convention), HTTP surface via `createAgentApp` or equivalent, Zod input schema with `tickerId` (required), optional `timeWindow`, optional `maxBatchSize`, optional `reanalyze` default false. Enforce that when `reanalyze` is true at least one of `timeWindow` or `maxBatchSize` is set. Integrate agent-data-api analysis GET using SDK with existing token auth (FR8). Empty `dataSources` returns success with zero work. Slice eligible sources to first N after stable sort when over `maxBatchSize`.
- Out of scope: LLM extraction, entity POST payloads, mentions, scoring (later tickets).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Agent package builds and runs locally with documented env vars consistent with other agents (`AGENT_DATA_API_URL`, auth, model keys as needed for later tickets).
- [ ] Input validation rejects `reanalyze=true` without `timeWindow` and without `maxBatchSize`.
- [ ] Default run uses GET with `unanalyzed=true` when `reanalyze` is false.
- [ ] Reanalyze run uses GET with `unanalyzed=false` or equivalent per API contract for re-scoring.
- [ ] Empty GET response completes without POST calls.
- [ ] When eligible count exceeds `maxBatchSize`, only the first N in deterministic order are processed in later pipeline stages (hook points may stub until MP-ART-ANALYSIS-004).
- [ ] Unit tests cover input validation, GET flag selection, empty response, and batch capping logic.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-001
- Blocks: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-004

## Notes

Reuse patterns from [data-collection](apps/mediapulse/agents/data-collection) and [`createAgentApp`](packages/shared/agent-runtime/src/create-agent-app.ts). If MP-ART-ANALYSIS-002 adds server `timeWindow`, pass those query params on GET. Otherwise filter GET results by `createdAt` on the agent before capping.
